'''Intelligence community''' was a term used to describe the combined intelligence apparatus of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] government. It included the [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service]], the [[Galactic Alliance Fleet Intelligence]], briefly the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]], and [[Galactic Alliance Security]].

[[Galactic Alliance Intelligence officer]]s and [[Agent/Legends|agents]], as well as their organizations, could be called "members" of the intelligence community.
